title: Object-store writes can report failure after durable mutation succeeds
description: Evidence: object-store persists object changes, appends the event log, then awaits object-index applyChanges; non-lock SQLite/filesystem errors can still throw from index update. Impact: a cache-update failure after durable commit makes the command report failure, inviting retries that duplicate effects or confuse operators.
acceptanceCriteria: Post-commit index updates are best-effort with diagnostics/rebuild-needed state, or index work moves before durable commit with rollback semantics.
Injected applyChanges failure tests prove either successful command with rebuildable cache or no durable mutation after returned error.
closedReason: Durable mutations no longer return failure solely because the disposable index update failed.
